courses.name: Software Engineering
courses.description: Comprehensive coverage of software development lifecycle, design patterns, agile methodologies, and modern development practices. Students learn to architect, design, and implement large-scale software systems using industry-standard tools and frameworks.
learningOutcomes: Understand and apply software engineering principles and best practices
Master object-oriented analysis and design techniques
Implement design patterns for robust, maintainable code
Practice agile development methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
Utilize version control systems and collaborative development workflows
Conduct comprehensive software testing and quality assurance
Document technical specifications and system architectures

courses.name: Database Management Systems
courses.description: In-depth exploration of relational database concepts, SQL programming, database design principles, transaction management, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience with enterprise database systems and NoSQL alternatives.
learningOutcomes: Design normalized database schemas following best practices
Write complex SQL queries for data manipulation and analysis
Implement database transactions with ACID properties
Optimize database performance through indexing and query tuning
Understand database security and access control mechanisms
Compare relational and NoSQL database paradigms
Design and implement database-driven web applications
topics: Advanced SQL: Joins, Subqueries, Views, Stored Procedures

courses.name: Web Technologies
courses.description: Modern web development covering both frontend and backend technologies. Students build full-stack applications using contemporary frameworks, implement RESTful APIs, and learn responsive design principles and security best practices.
learningOutcomes: Develop responsive, accessible web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
Build dynamic single-page applications with React or Vue.js
Implement server-side applications using Node.js or PHP frameworks
Design and consume RESTful APIs
Apply web security principles and prevent common vulnerabilities
Optimize web application performance and loading times
Deploy and maintain web applications on cloud platforms
topics: CSS3, Flexbox, and Grid Layout Systems
Backend Development: Node.js, Express, PHP Laravel
Web Security: XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection Prevention

courses.name: System Analysis and Design
courses.description: Systematic approach to analyzing organizational requirements and designing information systems. Covers methodologies, modeling techniques, and tools for developing business solutions that align with organizational goals.
learningOutcomes: Conduct comprehensive systems analysis and feasibility studies
Gather and document user requirements effectively
Create process models using DFDs and activity diagrams
Design system architectures and component interactions
Apply structured and object-oriented analysis techniques
Evaluate alternative system designs and make informed decisions
Manage system implementation and change processes
